from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, os, subprocess
root=Path('/tmp/qs-cleanup-fixture-WVw0fC')
expected={'README.md':'b359dac71529557534db6d17d0f6cb6086549886b07c8f5566bb880ae9318005','package.json':'8959fd8c93f891cf980514244403d56b4fffa19a3f171d661306aee24e25e7d3','check.mjs':'31c0efd10ff6c1c8fb3e7a2f1e81ea4683ba7eca511cbb20bc76cbbeed1b716b','docs/adr.md':'9fef57cc2965f9b78d113740312c0b8963ad6424058e19e8dbcae7a7a5735a9f'}
def snapshot():
    result={}
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        dirs[:]=sorted(d for d in dirs if d "'!= '"'.git')
        for name in sorted(dirs+files):
            p=Path(base)/name
            s=p.lstat()
            digest=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() else None
            result[str(p.relative_to(root))]=(s.st_mode,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,digest)
    return result
before=snapshot()
for name,digest in expected.items():
    assert before[name][3]==digest, name
check=subprocess.run(['node','check.mjs'],cwd=root,timeout=15)
assert check.returncode==0, 'checker failed'
after=snapshot()
assert before==after, 'fixture changed during validation'
print('Verified: node check.mjs exited 0; all four file hashes and fixture path/state inventory unchanged; no generated outputs.')
PY"
